reasoning: In 2023, researchers Daniel Martin Katz, Michael J. Bommarito II, and colleagues published a study demonstrating that OpenAI's GPT-4 successfully passed the Uniform Bar Exam (UBE). The model achieved a score of 297, placing it in approximately the 90th percentile of test-takers. Although a subsequent re-evaluation by researcher Eric Martinez argued that this 90th percentile claim was inflated due to comparison metrics (suggesting the model's actual performance was closer to the 68th percentile of all test-takers), both analyses confirm that the AI model passed the exam. A score in the 68th percentile remains well above the median (50th percentile) average score, making the claim accurate. Newer iterations of AI models have continued to match or exceed these benchmarks.
title: AI systems now pass the bar exam
